Our services

One team for your home, landscape, and irrigation

We combine the knowledge, professional training, and disciplined operating standards customers expect from a larger company with the personal service of a local business.

General Pest Solutions

Comprehensive quarterly pest control and prevention. We conduct thorough interior and exterior inspections to find access points, using Integrated Pest Management techniques in a pet-friendly way.

Termite Solutions

Thorough inspections and targeted treatment for termite issues, with advanced termite bait stations, an assessment of conducive conditions, and an annual termite bond for ongoing protection.

Lawn & Shrub Solutions

Comprehensive lawn, shrub, and palm care: fertilization, soil amendments, disease control, weed control, and targeted insect treatments, on customized bimonthly treatments.

Irrigation Solutions

An irrigation inspection that keeps your system operating at peak efficiency: thorough checks of valves, nozzles, and sprinkler heads, plus expert leak detection to conserve water.

Entire Home Solutions

A comprehensive inspection of your home, landscape, and irrigation system, safeguarding your property from unwanted pests, weeds, and termites — with expert evaluations that identify potential threats.

About us

A locally owned company built on integrity

Integrity Home Solutions is a locally owned Central Florida home-service company founded by Jordan Palmer, a Florida Certified Pest Operator and the company’s Certified Operator in Charge, with more than 16 years of industry experience serving Central Florida.

Our customer promise is simple: we inspect first, recommend only what the property needs, explain our findings clearly, perform responsible service, and follow through on what we promise.

  • Strong customer support and dedication to protecting your home
  • A proactive approach that guarantees your satisfaction and peace of mind
  • Highly trained technicians you can trust
